g.text: V16 | Actual nonlinear sampled control law
Mathematical blocks for the trained whole-body QP controller; Q has 19 coordinates, v has 18 components, tau has 12.
IK/reference feedback and acceleration clipping are inside the sampled control law. QP uses 320 finite ADMM iterations.
Gamma_T: 20 ms slew clipping before hold. Gamma_5ms: speed/effort envelope after hold. Model and physical contact forces are distinct.
